{"id":1978374515,"question_id":4278,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 1 week","timestamp":1776179131,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1978374515/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Value of Concatenated Binary Segments","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using pi = pair<int,int>;\n    int mod = 1e9 + 7;\n\n    static bool mycomp(const pair<int,int>&a , const pair<int,int>&b)\n    {\n        if(a.first == b.first) return a.second > b.second;\n        return a.first > b.first;\n    }\n\n    long long binaryToDecimal(string &s)\n    {\n        long long ans = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<s.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            ans = ans * 2 + (s[i] - '0');\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n\n    int maxValue(vector<int>& nums1, vector<int>& nums0) {\n        vector<pi>pairs;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums1.size() ; i++) pairs.push_back({nums1[i] , nums0[i]});\n\n        sort(begin(pairs) , end(pairs) , mycomp);\n\n        string formed = \"\";\n        for(auto it : pairs)\n        {\n            auto[ones , zeros] = it;\n            while(ones--) formed += '1';\n            while(zeros--) formed += '0';\n        }\n\n        return binaryToDecimal(formed) % mod;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-value-of-concatenated-binary-segments","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1921}
